subject: Proposed onward transfer to StorageBridge — consent request (VectorCloud)
thread_summary: Redwood notifies VectorCloud of a proposed onward transfer of customer data to StorageBridge (a storage subprocessor). VectorCloud requests evidence (SOC 2, encryption at rest/location, SCCs). Redwood provides SOC2 link, subprocessor statement and proposes DPA amendment via DocuSign. VectorCloud legal signs off with a minor logging requirement and asks for execution of the DPA amendment.
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@vectorcloud.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed onward transfer to StorageBridge — consent request (VectorCloud)

Hi Alex —

Quick heads-up: as part of an infrastructure optimization for cold object storage, Redwood intends to engage StorageBridge (a US-based storage provider) as a subprocessor for encrypted long-term blob storage. This will involve customer blobs used for VectorCloud production workflows being stored on StorageBridge-managed infrastructure.

Per Section 4.3 of our DPA, we are providing notice and requesting consent for any onward transfer that changes the set of subprocessors that may process VectorCloud data. Attached is our current subprocessor roster (redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx) with the StorageBridge entry highlighted, and a short StorageBridge subprocessor statement (storagebridge_subproc_statement.pdf).

Key points:
- Data type: encrypted object blobs (application-level AES-256).
- Location: StorageBridge US-East (primary) with optional cross-region replication to US-West (both within SCC countries).
- SCCs / international transfers: no change in export destinations beyond what’s in our DPA; we will apply SCCs where required.
- SOC2: StorageBridge has a SOC 2 Type II report; link included below.

Request: please confirm whether VectorCloud provides consent for this onward transfer within 7 business days (by EOD 2026-06-25). If you need more evidence (SOC 2 report, encryption configuration, DPIA excerpt), let us know and we’ll send immediately. If you require a DPA amendment, we can prepare one and route via DocuSign.

Links/evidence included:
- Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/vec-onward-transfer-evidence
- HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/VectorCloud

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx, storagebridge_subproc_statement.pdf

Thanks — we want to make this as fast and transparent as possible.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@vectorcloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: VectorCloud Legal <legal@vectorcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:47:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed onward transfer to StorageBridge — consent request (VectorCloud)

Thanks for the heads-up, Stephanie — appreciate the early notice. A couple of clarifying Qs from our security and legal teams before we can consent: 

1) Where are the encryption keys stored/managed? Is Redwood managing keys (KMS) or will StorageBridge hold keys in their KMS/HSM?
2) Does StorageBridge perform any subcontracting or cross-border transfers that would move data outside the US? We need to ensure compatibility with our SCCs and existing Data Processing Addendum.
3) Can you provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II (or authorisation letter) for StorageBridge and their most recent penetration test summary?

We received the roster and statement, but VectorCloud Legal would like a short, one-paragraph addendum clarifying logging retention (we prefer 90 days for object access logs) and confirming Redwood will notify us of any changes to StorageBridge that materially affect security controls.

I've attached StorageBridge's service overview that StorageBridge sent us earlier (StorageBridge-svc-overview.pdf). Looping in legal so they can flag any DPA amendment needs.

— Alex
Alex Harper
Senior Security Engineer, VectorCloud
alex.harper@vectorcloud.com
From: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@vectorcloud.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed onward transfer to StorageBridge — consent request (VectorCloud)

Alex —

Thanks for the prompt review and thoughtful questions. Quick answers and the evidence bundle below: 

1) Key management: Redwood will retain customer-managed keys by default in our KMS; StorageBridge will not have access to plaintext keys. For customers that opt-in to Redwood-managed keys, keys are stored in Redwood's KMS (HSM-backed). We will not put customer KMS keys into StorageBridge's KMS.

2) Transfers: StorageBridge operates primarily in the US. Cross-region replication is US-East <-> US-West only. No transfers outside SCC-covered jurisdictions for VectorCloud data unless explicitly requested and agreed. SCCs will be applied where required.

3) Evidence: attached are links to StorageBridge's SOC 2 Type II summary and our redacted DPIA excerpt. We have also attached storagebridge_subproc_statement.pdf (same as earlier) and a draft DPA amendment (dpa_amendment_proposal.docx) that includes the 90-day logging retention clause you requested.

We will commit to notification of any material changes to StorageBridge security posture and will provide updated evidence within 5 business days of material change detection.

Attachments / links provided:
- StorageBridge SOC 2 summary (redacted link): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/file/0Bxyz/storagebridge-soc2-summary.pdf
- DPIA excerpt (redwood DPIA — storage segment): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/file/0Bxyz/redwood-dpia-storage-excerpt.pdf
- DPA amendment (draft): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC123/onward-dpa-amendment

If VectorCloud Legal confirms the logging retention language is acceptable, we can finalize the DocuSign route today. Let us know and we’ll send the DPA amendment to the signers listed in your HubSpot record.

— Priyom Das
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
From: VectorCloud Legal <legal@vectorcloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Harper <alex.harper@vectorcloud.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed onward transfer to StorageBridge — consent request (VectorCloud)

Stephanie / Priyom —

VectorCloud Legal has reviewed the materials and we are prepared to provide consent for the onward transfer to StorageBridge subject to the following: 

- Redwood will include the 90-day object access logging retention clause in the DPA amendment (we reviewed the draft and the clause is present).
- Redwood will notify VectorCloud within 3 business days of any material security incidents at StorageBridge that may affect VectorCloud data.

Please route the DPA amendment via DocuSign to legal@vectorcloud.com and to our authorized signee (cc'ed via HubSpot). Once the DocuSign is executed we will record consent under our vendor register.

DocuSign link received and approved: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC123/onward-dpa-amendment

Thanks for the timely coordination.

— VectorCloud Legal
legal@vectorcloud.com
